lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of large, high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly vertical columns of three to four units on the lateral mid-flank, posterior to the gill slits and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible on the lateral flank, intersecting with the large circular blobs to create a grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges run across the upper flank; the dorsal-most ridge exhibits a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the upper edge and defined shadow directly beneath it.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains approximately 5 to 7 large, discrete high-luminance blobs primarily concentrated within the lower and medial portions of the fin's silhouette.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_distribution: The spots within the first dorsal fin are sparsely distributed compared to the anterior body regions, showing clear separation between individual high-intensity clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, high-reflectance linear feature is visible trailing from the ventral-posterior region near the pelvic fin, consistent with an external tag or trailing attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: There is a sharp transition in spatial frequency of the patterning, from high-density, small-diameter spots on the anterior snout to low-density, large-diameter spots on the lateral mid-body.
